text.tspan: The American Association of Physician Assistants (AAPA) wants to estimate the average starting annual
salary for physician assistants. They want to create a 95% confidence interval with a margin of error no
more than $5000. Prior estimates show that the standard deviation is approximately $32,000. Find the
minimum sample size they need for this margin of error.
We are told the organization wants to estimate the average starting salary of physician assistants.
Salary is a quantitative variable, and the average is referring to the mean. So, we are dealing with
, not proportions. We are told they want to create a 95% confidence interval with a margin of
error of no more than $5000. The last sentence asks us to
